feeds.title: Wearing History Blog
feeds.description: Wearing History is a Vintage Revival Clothing, Sewing Patterns Blog by Lauren. This blog is a journal of my journey with sewing and costume history, including research, projects, endeavors, and miscellaneous adventures.

feeds.title: Glamour Daze
feeds.description: A lavishly illustrated archive and blog of vintage fashion and beauty, with gorgeous imagery, films, educational reading and pretty things to buy.

feeds.title: American Duchess Blog
feeds.description: Lauren Stowell is a historical costumer, footwear designer, and co-founder of American Duchess Historical Footwear. American Duchess is a costume blog designed to educate and entertain those interested in learning more about the fashions of the 18th century and other periods of dress.

feeds.title: Fashion-Era
feeds.description: Fashion-Era analysis the change of social, history and lifestyle to the current and historical fashion trends.

feeds.title: The Dreamstress
feeds.description: I'm Leimomi Oakes, a costumier fashion and textile historian, former museum professional, potential Ph.D. student, sewing teacher, writer, and more. The Dreamstress website is a window into my world: my projects, new things I learn, things I know so well I can teach, the amazing places I live and the amazing places I visit, the wonderful people I am surrounded by, anything interesting that catches my fancy that I think might catch yours, and, of course, Felicity the cat.

feeds.title: University of Fashion Blog » Fashion History
feeds.description: This section features articles on fashion history. The University of Fashion is the first and largest online fashion design video library in the world. We have many hundreds of step-by-step video lessons teaching all aspects of fashion design.

feeds.title: Documenting Fashion
feeds.description: This is a blog that documents fashion - as an image, as an object, as text, as an experience, and as an industry. Written by Rebecca Arnold, Lecturer in History of Dress and Textiles, and current postgraduate and research students of the history of dress at The Courtauld Institute of Art in London. We aim to share our ideas, show you items from The Courtauld's collections, and generally discuss anything that we think is interesting and provocative about fashion now, as well as in the past.

feeds.title: Vintage Dancer
feeds.description: Browse thousands of vintage inspired clothing, shoes, and accessories for women and men to buy online. Learn fashion history and easy DIY costume & outfit ideas.

feeds.title: Charm Patterns » Fashion History
feeds.description: Specializing in vintage glamour, Gertie is a designer who infuses her passion for sewing into glamorous creations that can be customized for anyone. In 2017, Gertie launched her own independent pattern line called Charm Patterns.

feeds.title: The Costumer's Manifesto
feeds.description: Costumer's Manifesto is a defacto guide for everything fashion from old to new. Find articles on everything inluding 1900s fashion, history of fashion, changes in trends, newer trends and more!

feeds.title: The Lost Art of Dress
feeds.description: Fashion, dressmaking, and millinery, both vintage and modern, from a historian who practices the crafts. Linda Przybyszewski, Ph.D., AKA Professor Pski, teaches U.S. history at the University of Notre Dame.

feeds.title: Fashion Time Warp
feeds.description: Welcome to Fashion Time Warp, your virtual time machine to the riveting world of fashion history. Here, we peel back the layers of time to unveil the stories behind the fabrics, accessories, and style trends that have shaped societies. With a medley of visually rich illustrations, thoughtful analyses, and trendspotting insights, we offer a curated experience like no other.

feeds.title: Emily's Vintage Visions
feeds.description: A blog by Emily. She always loved vintage and historic fashions. Emily's main focus is the 18th century but she loves the classy look of the 1920s, through the 1950s. Emily enjoys researching, collecting, and creating historic clothing just for fun.

feeds.title: History Of Fashion
feeds.description: History of fashion includes articles and images on historical fashion through last few centuries with the author's take on subsequent fashion trends.

feeds.title: History of Fashion
feeds.description: A look at the history of fashion all over the world through paintings, photography, and surviving outfits.
